# LinkedIn Company Details

> Send a LinkedIn company URL. You get the website, industry, size, headquarters, locations, specialties, and recent posts.

Mawsool publishes this as an Apify Actor. Starting from $0.90 per 1,000 companies.

## Run

- Apify Actor: https://apify.com/oday/mawsool-linkedin-company-details
- Call: `oday/mawsool-linkedin-company-details`
- API key: https://mawsool.tech/ and https://docs.mawsool.tech/
- Contact: osama@mawsool.tech, info@mawsool.tech

## Use it when

You want the full company record from a URL you already have.

## Use something else when

You only need the website, industry, and employee range. Use Firmographics. You have a person, not a company URL. Use Profile to Company Website.

## Page

- LinkedIn company details from a company URL: docs/linkedin-company-details.md

Mawsool is not affiliated with LinkedIn.
